values.placeholder: Leave empty to use your business address

nodes.name: Poll: guest answered or delivery failed
Your settings
nodes.notes:
owner_phone: your own number, with + and country code. It gets the exceptions and the decline notes. It must be a different phone from the number linked to Turbo Notify.
business_name: used in the event title and in the texts.
business_location: used when the form's Location is empty.
expected_timezone: the time zone of the times you type. Runs stop if the workflow time zone (Workflow settings, Timezone) differs.
default_country_code: added to local numbers typed without +. Works for 55 (Brazil). With another code only numbers that start with it, or with +, are accepted.
reminder_hours_before: the invitation goes out when the appointment is this many hours away or less.
min_notice_minutes: no invitation for an appointment that starts sooner than this.
invite_alarm_minutes_before: WhatsApp reminds the guest this many minutes before the start.
no_answer_window_hours: a customer who has not tapped is listed once the appointment is this close. 0 switches that report off.
default_duration_minutes: used when the form's duration is empty.
allow_extra_guests: let guests bring extra people (the answer then carries a count).
max_text_length: longest name, title, location or note the form accepts.
max_appointments_per_day: the form refuses more new appointments than this in 24 hours.
invite_text: the text of the invitation. {name} first name, {business}, {when}, {where}. A line with {where} is dropped when there is no location. \n is a line break.
thanks_going_text: sent when the guest taps Going. {name}, {title}, {business}, {when}, {guests} (the extra guests sentence, empty at 0).
thanks_maybe_text: sent when the guest taps Maybe. Same placeholders.
decline_customer_text: sent when the guest taps Not going. {name}, {title}, {business}, {when}.
date_format: how {when} is written (Luxon tokens). Weekday and month names come out in English.

assignments.name: invite_text
thanks_going_text
assignments.value: Thank you, {name}. Your {title} appointment at {business} on {when} is confirmed.{guests}

assignments.name: thanks_maybe_text
assignments.value: Thank you, {name}. We noted that you might come to your {title} appointment on {when}.{guests} Please tell us here as soon as you know.

assignments.name: decline_customer_text
assignments.value: Thank you for letting us know, {name}. We will contact you to reschedule your {title} appointment.

nodes.name: Send the customer contact card to the owner

parameters.content:
### How it works
For clinics, salons, tutors and studios. Staff add appointments with a form. Every hour, each customer whose appointment is coming up gets a native WhatsApp calendar invitation, once.

The customer taps Going, Maybe or Not going. The workflow records the answer and thanks them. A decline texts you with the customer's contact card.

Each hourly run sends you ONE message listing only what needs you: reminders that failed and customers who have not answered. Guests on personal WhatsApp accounts see the invitation without the time card, so the text repeats it.

### Setup
1. Install @turbo-notify/n8n-nodes-turbo-notify (tested with 1.5.15).
2. Create a Turbo Notify API credential with the scopes messages:send, messages:read and events:read, and a Basic Auth credential for the form.
3. In Your settings set owner_phone (not the number linked to Turbo Notify) and expected_timezone, the same zone as in Workflow settings.
4. Run "Run once: create the table", add a first row with the form, then activate.

### Customization
Edit the texts and the date format in Your settings. A row marked not_reminded, send_failed or invalid_phone shows why: fix it and set it back to scheduled.

## Create the table (run once)

Sets up the appointments table the first time. Then add a row with the form.

## Entry points

Three ways in: the form, the hourly timer and the answers.

## Add appointments

Staff add a booking with the form. A valid one is saved, a rejected one is explained.

## Read the quota and the due rows

Keeps one message free for your report and reads only rows inside the reminder window.

## Send and record

Each invitation goes out once. The row keeps the message id or the reason it failed.

## Wait, then report

Waits for every invitation, then tells you only what needs you in one message.

## Record the answers

Records Going, Maybe, Not going or a failed delivery.

## Texts and contact card

Thanks the customer. A decline also sends you the contact card.

## Your settings and routing

Every run starts with your values, then goes to the form, the report or the answers.
